body:
Not an easy topic indeed, this is also the current behavior in instantsearch.js V1 (the one that is surprising).

I have no silver bullet for this and what you propose @redox can be disturbing as well I guess since the changes in pagination UI are very small (page change) compared to the fact that the whole page is gonna be updated after scrolling top.

What could work is a very fast/nice fadein fadeout effect. And having the API semantics to be able to trigger that.
